 URL = "https://openlibrary.org/search.json"
 
 
 def get_books(url, author):
     # Returns two things: (books, error).
     # It worked:   (first 10 books, None)
     # It didn't:   (None, a short reason), so app.py can show a message
     try:

 import requests
 
 GEOCODING_URL = "https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com/v1/search"
 FORECAST_URL = "https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast"
 
 
 def get_today_high(city):
     try:
         geocoding_response = requests.get(
             GEOCODING_URL,
             params={"name": city, "count": 1, "language": "en", "format": "json"},
             timeout=10,
         )
         geocoding_response.raise_for_status()
         locations = geocoding_response.json().get("results", [])
 
         if not locations:
             return None, "no_city"
 
         location = locations[0]
         forecast_response = requests.get(
             FORECAST_URL,
             params={
                 "latitude": location["latitude"],
                 "longitude": location["longitude"],
                 "daily": "temperature_2m_max",
                 "forecast_days": 1,
                 "timezone": location.get("timezone") or "auto",
             },
             timeout=10,
         )
         forecast_response.raise_for_status()
         highs = forecast_response.json()["daily"]["temperature_2m_max"]
         high = highs[0]
 
         if not isinstance(high, (int, float)):
             return None, "unavailable"
 
         return high, None
     except requests.RequestException:
         return None, "unavailable"
     except (AttributeError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, IndexError):
         return None, "unavailable"
